lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb4AuI4 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with a 16-atom unit cell (Rb8Au4I8) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Au centers in a tetrahedral environment of four I neighbors (2.7697 Å), while Rb centers coordinate to four I neighbors (3.6426–3.7022 Å). The Au-centered tetrahedra and the Rb-centered 4-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-sharing, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component.
